title: SharePoint: Neutral-themed SharePoint UI in Page Editing and Property Panes
description: Coming soon for SharePoint: Neutral-themed SharePoint UI will be expanded to page editing and property pane experiences. This update is part of the SharePoint visual refresh and applies our new design language across the SharePoint page editing surfaces, helping create a more consistent, accessible, and modern editing experience.
